themes.name: Base
themes.note: Pure white and black, electric blue

themes.name: Grove
themes.note: Olive paper, sage, a serif voice

themes.name: Candy
themes.note: Blush paper, rose, soft round keys

styles.name: Soft
styles.note: Grey shells, white panels, gentle shadows

styles.name: Keycap
styles.note: Raised keys with a real bottom edge

styles.name: Brutal
styles.note: Ink borders and hard offset shadows

components.name: Button
components.description: A keycap with a real bottom edge. It lifts on hover and sinks when pressed.
props: Shows a spinner and blocks clicks.
Render the child element, such as a router link, with button styles.

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: One choice from a short set. A raised pill slides to the chosen option.
props: { value: string; label: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]

components.name: Dropdown menu
components.description: A menu of actions with shortcuts, checkable items and nested submenus.
props: Key hint shown on the right.

components.name: Input
components.description: A text field with optional leading and trailing slots. Pair it with Field for label, hint and error.
components.usage:
<Field label="Email" htmlFor="email" hint="We never share it.">
  <Input id="email" leading={<AtSign />} />
</Field>
props: Icon or text before the value.
Icon, key hint or button after the value.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line field that shares the input's border, focus ring and error states.

components.name: Select
components.description: A listbox for picking one value, with groups, labels and disabled options.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A binary or indeterminate choice, for lists where many items can be on.

components.name: Radio group
components.description: One choice from a visible set. RadioCard wraps each option in a selectable panel.

components.name: Switch
components.description: An on and off setting that applies immediately.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Pick a value or a range by dragging. Pass two values for a range.
props: One value, or two for a range.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A modal window that traps focus and returns it to the trigger when closed.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Rich, interactive content anchored to a trigger.
props: Gap from the trigger in px.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short label on hover or focus, with an optional key hint. Wrap your app in TooltipProvider.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Brief, non-blocking messages. Mount Toaster once and call toast() from anywhere.
components.usage:
toast("Saved")
toast.success("Deployed", "acme-web is live.")
toast({ title: "Archived", action: { label: "Undo", onClick } })

components.name: Alert
components.description: An inline message about the state of a page or section.
props: Shows a close button when set.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Linear progress for a task, and Meter, a cell meter for quotas.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A shimmering placeholder that holds the shape of content while it loads.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: An indeterminate loading indicator that inherits the text colour.

components.name: Card
components.description: A hairline-bordered surface with header, content and a footer strip.
props: Every part accepts className and native div props.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: An image with initials as fallback, a presence dot, and an overlapping group.
props: Initials when there is no image.
Collapse the rest into a count.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A compact label for status, version or category.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: A keyboard key, for shortcuts in menus, tooltips and docs.

components.name: Separator
components.description: A hairline between groups of content, horizontal or vertical.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switch between views in place. Two variants: a tray with a sliding pill, and a line.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Stacked sections that expand one or many at a time.
props: Allow closing the open item in single mode.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: A select with a search field, for option lists too long to scan.
props: { value: string; label: string; description?: string }[]

components.name: Input OTP
components.description: One-time code entry with auto-advance, paste support and grouped cells.
props: Insert a gap after this many cells.
Called when every cell is filled.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A panel that slides in from an edge, for forms and details that keep page context.

components.name: Alert dialog
components.description: A modal that interrupts to confirm an important or irreversible action.
props: Danger style for the confirm button.

components.name: Table
components.description: Ruled data table parts with selectable rows and a sortable header button.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Where the current page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Move through pages of results, with gaps for long ranges.
props: Pages shown either side of the current one.

components.name: Button group
components.description: Buttons fused into one row, for ranges and paired actions.
props: The fused buttons. Inner corners square off automatically.

components.name: Password input
components.description: A password field with a show and hide key and an optional strength meter.
props: Four-step meter and the rules under the field.
Everything Input accepts, except type and trailing.

components.name: Copy button
components.description: Copies a value and confirms with a check for a moment.
props: Text beside the icon; icon-only when omitted.
